patch_description: Proposes a reorganized, more entangled ansatz within a single block by splitting the perimeter CRX ring into two segments with a hub CRY layer in between. This “ring–hub–ring” arrangement preserves parameter efficiency (same 11 unique block parameters), depth, and connectivity constraints, but enhances entanglement mixing across the tic-tac-toe qubit layout. It interleaves a four-edge CRX ring, a CRY hub connecting the center to edge qubits, and then the remaining four CRX ring edges, followed by post-entanglement RZ rotations. This structure aims to improve validation/test accuracy and reduce train-test gap while preserving the fixed training loop, data construction, measurements, and overall block semantics (N_UPLOADS=3, N_REPEATS=2, feature map as specified, and per-block parameter sharing).
